name: ciro-code
description: Ciro Code open-core harness kernel (no proprietary UI / four-mode Profile source)

scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @ciro-code/cli exec node dist/cli.js web --no-open
scripts.dev:web:mock: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @ciro-code/cli exec node dist/cli.js web --mock --no-open
scripts.build:docs: npm run check:i18n --prefix docs && npm run build --prefix docs && npm run check:base-links --prefix docs
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:website && npm run build:docs && npm run package:pages
